info.title: DailySpeak API
info.description: HTTP API for DailySpeak. Mobile clients use the stable `/api/v1` contract with short-lived bearer access tokens and rotating opaque refresh tokens. The legacy web cookie contract remains available during migration.

get.summary: Read the current mobile API version

post.summary: Create a short-lived guest identity
Register an account and optionally upgrade a guest
post.description: When a guest Bearer token is supplied, its identity is merged into the new account in the same transaction.

post.summary: Sign in and optionally merge a guest identity
post.description: When a guest Bearer token is supplied, its identity is merged into the account atomically.

post.summary: Rotate a refresh token and issue a new access token
post.description: Each refresh token is single-use. Reuse revokes the entire device session.

get.summary: Read the current mobile identity and device session

post.summary: Revoke the current device session
Revoke every device session for the current identity

get.summary: List owned recordings with cursor pagination
get.description: Returns recordings ordered by timestamp and id descending. Cursors are opaque and must be sent back unchanged.

post.summary: Create a recording from ready media assets
post.description: Atomically attaches owned ready audio and optional photo assets, reserves quota, and enqueues durable processing. A user access token and an Idempotency-Key are required; guest identities cannot start paid processing.

get.summary: Load one owned recording from the v1 API

post.summary: Create an owned resumable media upload
post.description: Creates an upload plan for recording audio or a recording photo. The client computes the complete-object SHA-256 before starting. A user access token and Idempotency-Key are required; guest identities receive account_required.

get.description: Returns upload state and the parts already accepted by storage. A foreign upload is reported as not found.

delete.description: Idempotently aborts an incomplete upload. A completed upload cannot be aborted.

post.summary: Create short-lived upload requests for media parts
post.description: Returns opaque bounded upload requests. Send exactly the returned method, URL, and headers; URLs are short-lived and must never be persisted.

post.summary: Complete and verify an owned media upload
post.description: Completes multipart storage and verifies the whole-object size and SHA-256. Repeating a successful completion is idempotent.

get.summary: Create a short-lived authorized media download request
get.description: Returns an opaque request for an owned ready asset. Foreign, deleted, and non-ready assets are all reported as not found. The returned URL must not be persisted.

put.summary: Upload one part to local media storage
put.description: Local-storage transport endpoint. Invoke only the opaque signed URL returned by the parts endpoint. Signature, expiry, size, and checksum are bound into the URL; no bearer token is sent.

get.summary: Download signed content from local media storage
get.description: Local-storage transport endpoint. Invoke only the opaque signed URL returned by the authorized download endpoint; no bearer token is sent.

post.summary: Register a user and create a session
Sign in and create a session
Delete current session cookie

get.description: Uses optional auth cookie. If authenticated, the user's saved English level overrides the `level` query parameter.

parameters.name: avoid
parameters.description: Questions to avoid; may be repeated.

questions: How do you usually plan a short trip?
What technology helps you study better?
How do you keep a healthy morning routine?

get.summary: Generate follow-up questions and words for a topic
Load user profile data, recordings, quota and subscription

post.summary: Activate or extend subscription by one month
Save a full base64 recording for background processing
post.description: Legacy/fallback upload flow. Backend saves the recording immediately, returns it with `status=processing`, then runs transcription, AI suggestions, and the natural conversational rewrite in separate background steps.

delete.summary: Permanently delete a recording and related feed content
delete.description: Deletes the owned recording, its Feed publication, replies and reactions, and durably queues recording and reply audio files for removal from server storage.

post.summary: Retry a failed recording-processing stage
post.description: Atomically claims an owned failed recording and resumes from its stored processing stage. Transcription reuses saved audio; AI analysis reuses the transcript; the natural rewrite reuses both the transcript and accepted suggestions. An already-processing recording is returned without starting a duplicate job.

200.description: Current recording state and whether a new retry job was scheduled.

post.summary: Generate pronunciation audio for the corrected transcript
post.description: Claims an owned recording for background Cartesia synthesis. Ready or recently processing recordings are returned without starting a duplicate job.

200.description: Current recording state after scheduling or deduplication.

post.summary: Start chunked recording upload session
Upload one recording chunk
Upload the final complete recording audio
post.description: Uploads the complete browser-created Blob for the session. Backend prefers this file over raw chunk concatenation when finishing the recording.

post.summary: Finish chunked upload and start background processing

200.description: Session was already finalized; existing recording returned.

post.summary: Publish a saved recording to the feed
Create a voice reply for a feed post
Set or clear current user's reaction for a post
Set or clear current user's reaction for a reply

get.description: Returns a persisted shadowing MP3 only when the session user owns the recording whose active shadowing URL matches this path. Directory requests are rejected.
Serves recording and Feed media. Shadowing MP3s use the authenticated route documented separately.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path under the configured uploads directory, for example `recordings/user-id/recording.webm`.

cookieAuth.name: daily_speaking_session
cookieAuth.description: HTTP-only session cookie set by `/api/auth/register` and `/api/auth/login`.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access token returned by `/api/v1/auth/*`. Refresh tokens are sent only to the refresh endpoint.

RequestIdHeader.name: X-Request-ID
RequestIdHeader.description: Caller-generated diagnostic id. Unsafe values are replaced by the server.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Stable key for retrying this logical mutation. Reusing it with a different request returns a conflict.

MediaSignedSizeQuery.name: sizeBytes
MediaSignedSizeQuery.description: Signed exact Content-Length for this local upload part.

MediaSignedChecksumQuery.name: checksumSha256
MediaSignedChecksumQuery.description: Signed lowercase SHA-256 for this local upload part.

MediaSignedExpiryQuery.name: expires
MediaSignedExpiryQuery.description: Signed Unix expiry. Treat it as opaque client-side.

MediaSignatureQuery.name: signature
MediaSignatureQuery.description: HMAC signature for the local transport request. Treat it as opaque.

PageCursorQuery.name: cursor
PageCursorQuery.description: Opaque cursor returned in the previous page.

InterestQuery.name: interest
InterestQuery.description: Interest ids; may be repeated. Backend keeps up to 10.

V1RecordingPageOK.description: One stable page of owned recordings.

V1RecordingWithQuotaCreated.description: Recording created, media attached, and durable processing queued.

Location.description: Relative URL of the created upload resource.

V1MediaPartsOK.description: Short-lived opaque requests for the requested upload parts.

V1MediaDownloadOK.description: Short-lived opaque request for owned media content.

V1NoContent.description: Operation completed without a response body.

V1MediaPartStored.description: Local media part stored and verified.

ETag.description: Opaque part entity tag to send to the completion endpoint.

X-Checksum-SHA256.description: Verified lowercase SHA-256 of the uploaded part.

V1MediaContentOK.description: Verified local media content. The content type and length match the stored asset metadata.

V1IdentityCreated.description: Identity and device token grant created.

V1IdentityOK.description: Identity and rotated device token grant.

V1Forbidden.description: The authenticated identity cannot perform this operation; media mutations require a user account.

V1Conflict.description: Identity conflict or guest identity already merged.

V1UnsupportedMediaType.description: The media content type is not allowed for the requested purpose.

V1UnprocessableEntity.description: The declared size or SHA-256 does not match the uploaded bytes.

V1MethodNotAllowed.description: Method not allowed for this resource.

V1ServiceUnavailable.description: Mobile identity signing is not configured.

AuthUserOK.description: Authenticated user. Response also sets `daily_speaking_session` on login/register.

Unauthorized.description: Session cookie is missing or invalid.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Valid request, but audio could not be transcribed.

refreshToken.description: Single-use opaque refresh token returned by the previous grant.

accessToken.description: Short-lived signed JWT. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

refreshToken.description: Single-use opaque token. Store it only in secure device storage.

duration.description: Recording duration in seconds. Quota is reserved atomically when the recording is created.

contentType.description: Allowed audio types include WebM, MP4/M4A, Ogg, WAV, and MPEG. Allowed photo types are JPEG, PNG, WebP, and GIF.

sizeBytes.description: Exact whole-object size. Audio is limited to 80 MiB and photos to 4 MiB.

url.description: Opaque absolute or relative short-lived URL. Do not persist or modify it.

headers.description: Headers that must be copied exactly to the storage request.

AudioDataUrl.description: A `data:audio/*;base64,...` payload for incoming requests, or `/uploads/...` URL in stored responses.

downloadPath.description: Stable backend path. Call it with Bearer authentication to receive a short-lived opaque download request.

media.description: Private media references for mobile clients. Omitted for legacy records that have not been indexed as media assets.

reaction.description: Set one reaction. Use null or empty string to clear current reaction.
